mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are holding steady at 27 degrees with clear skies observed at Verona Community Park and a waxing crescent moon above.

City Hall is currently reviewing development projects, including a site plan and conditional use permit for the Sub-Zero project in Liberty Business Park, while also posting important notices for the upcoming November 2026 general election.
We have a full calendar this week, starting with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard, followed by live music tomorrow at Wisconsin Brewing Company and yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.

Looking at the weekly police report, officers responded to a call on October 25 where they arrested a 40-year-old man for O W I after locating him in his vehicle at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
If you are craving something sweet, head over to Culver's when they open today at 10 AM to enjoy their featured flavor of the day, OREO Cookie Cheesecake.
